title: RIP. Rebirth and Throbbing
description: Funeral music wakes the neighbourhood of Carolinas in Alicante. Neighbors dressed in mourning carry a coffin and flowers through its streets. But no death is commemorated, not yet. The neighbours of Carolinas will fight and cause their home to be reborn and to throb.
